data.name: Manifestation
data.description: The shaman becomes a spirit of death. Once per round, she can cast bleed or stabilize as a free action. If she is reduced to below 0 hit points, she automatically stabilizes. She can cast animate dead at will without paying a material component cost, although she is still subject to the usual Hit Dice control limit. Once per day, she can cast power word kill, but the spell can target a creature with 150 hit points or fewer.
